# cidaas_custom_provider (Resource)

Manages Custom Identity Providers in Cidaas (`v3.x` legacy `/providers-srv/custom` and `v4.x` `/federation/providers`).

~> **Note on Owner Assignment**: For cidaas v4.x (Trustdesk), all created provider configurations carry `owner: "client"` to guarantee full visibility and editability in the Admin UI dashboard (`adminui-srv`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cidaas_custom_provider" "example" {
  provider_name          = "custom_oidc_provider"
  display_name           = "Custom OpenID Connect Provider"
  standard_type          = "OIDC"
  client_id              = "your-client-id"
  client_secret          = "your-client-secret"
  authorization_endpoint = "https://idp.example.com/oauth2/v1/authorize"
  token_endpoint         = "https://idp.example.com/oauth2/v1/token"
  userinfo_endpoint      = "https://idp.example.com/oauth2/v1/userinfo"
  logo_url               = "https://cdn.example.com/logo.png"
  domains                = ["example.com"]
  pkce                   = true
  userinfo_source        = "USERINFOENDPOINT"
  owner                  = "client"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `authorization_endpoint` (String) Authorization endpoint URL.
- `client_id` (String) Client ID for authentication with the custom provider.
- `display_name` (String) Display name of the custom provider.
- `logo_url` (String) Logo URL of the provider.
- `provider_name` (String) Unique provider name.
- `standard_type` (String) Standard type of custom provider (`OAUTH2`, `OIDC`).
- `token_endpoint` (String) Token endpoint URL.

### Optional

- `auth_type` (String) Auth type setting.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Client Secret for authentication with the custom provider.
- `client_secret_wo` (String, Sensitive) Write-only client secret for authentication.
- `client_secret_wo_version` (String) Version of write-only client secret.
- `domains` (List of String) Allowed domain names for provider.
- `owner` (String) Owner of the provider (defaults to `client` for Admin UI compatibility).
- `pkce` (Boolean) Enable PKCE for provider flow.
- `scope_display_label` (String) Display label for scopes.
- `userinfo_endpoint` (String) Userinfo endpoint URL.
- `userinfo_source` (String) Userinfo source setting (`USERINFOENDPOINT`, `IDTOKEN`, `ACCESSTOKEN`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the custom provider.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import cidaas_custom_provider.example "custom_oidc_provider"
```
